stories.titleZh: 皮特猫：我爱我的白鞋子
stories.titleEn: Pete the Cat: I Love My White Shoes
keywords: 皮特猫：我爱我的白鞋子
Pete the Cat: I Love My White Shoes

pages.zh: 皮特猫穿着他的崭新的白鞋子在大街上走着。
pages.en: Pete the Cat was walking down the street in his brand new white shoes.

pages.zh: 皮特太爱他的白鞋子了，他唱起了歌："我爱我的白鞋子，我爱我的白鞋子……"
pages.en: Pete loved his white shoes so much, he sang a song: "I love my white shoes, I love my white shoes..."

pages.zh: 哦不！皮特踩进了一大堆草莓里。他的鞋子变成了什么颜色？
pages.en: Oh no! Pete stepped in a large pile of strawberries. What color did it turn his shoes?

pages.zh: 红色！皮特哭了吗？天哪，没有！他继续一边走一边唱着歌。"我爱我的红鞋子，我爱我的红鞋子……"
pages.en: RED! Did Pete cry? Goodness, no! He kept walking along and singing his song. "I love my red shoes, I love my red shoes..."

pages.zh: 哦不！皮特踩进了一大堆蓝莓里。他的鞋子变成了什么颜色？
pages.en: Oh no! Pete stepped in a large pile of blueberries. What color did it turn his shoes?

pages.zh: 蓝色！皮特哭了吗？天哪，没有！他继续边走边唱："我爱我的蓝鞋子，我爱我的蓝鞋子……"
pages.en: BLUE! Did Pete cry? Goodness, no! He kept walking along and singing his song. "I love my blue shoes, I love my blue shoes..."

pages.zh: 哦不！皮特踩进了一大滩泥巴里。他的鞋子变成了什么颜色？
pages.en: Oh no! Pete stepped in a large puddle of mud. What color did it turn his shoes?

pages.zh: 棕色！皮特哭了吗？天哪，没有！他继续边走边唱："我爱我的棕鞋子，我爱我的棕鞋子……"
pages.en: BROWN! Did Pete cry? Goodness, no! He kept walking along and singing his song. "I love my brown shoes, I love my brown shoes..."

pages.zh: 哦不！皮特踩进了一桶水里。他的鞋子怎么了？
pages.en: Oh no! Pete stepped in a bucket of water. What happened to his shoes?

pages.zh: 全湿了。但它们毕竟还是鞋子。皮特哭了吗？天哪，没有！他继续边走边唱。
pages.en: They were all wet. But they were still shoes. Did Pete cry? Goodness, no! He kept walking along and singing his song.

pages.zh: "我爱我的湿鞋子，我爱我的湿鞋子……"
pages.en: "I love my wet shoes, I love my wet shoes..."

pages.zh: 皮特的故事告诉我们：不管你踩到了什么，继续前进，继续唱你的歌。因为一切都会好起来的。
pages.en: The moral of Pete's story is: No matter what you step in, keep walking along and singing your song. Because it's all good.

stories.titleEn: Don't Let the Pigeon Drive the Bus
keywords: Don't Let the Pigeon Drive the Bus

pages.zh: 嗨！我是巴士司机。听着，我得离开一小会儿。你能帮我看着吗！太好了！记住——别让鸽子开巴士！
pages.en: Hi! I'm the bus driver. Listen, I have to leave for a little while. Can you watch things for me? Great! Just don't let the pigeon drive the bus!

pages.zh: 我是鸽子！让我开巴士吧！
pages.en: I'm the pigeon! Let me drive the bus!

pages.zh: 求你了？我会小心的！
pages.en: Please? I'll be careful!

pages.zh: 我跟你说：我就扶一下方向盘。
pages.en: I tell you what: I'll just steer.

pages.zh: 我表哥几乎每天都开巴士！真的！
pages.en: My cousin drives a bus almost every day! True story!

pages.zh: 我打赌你妈妈肯定让我开。
pages.en: I bet your mom would let me drive.

pages.zh: 有什么大不了的嘛！？
pages.en: What's the big deal?!

pages.zh: 不就一辆巴士嘛！！
pages.en: It's just a bus!!

pages.zh: 我也有梦想的好不好！我想当巴士司机！
pages.en: I have dreams, you know! I wanna be a bus driver!

pages.zh: 好吧。我当你最好的朋友。
pages.en: Fine. I'll be your best friend.

pages.zh: 要不我给你五块钱？
pages.en: How 'bout I give you five bucks?

pages.zh: 让我开巴士！！！
pages.en: LET ME DRIVE THE BUS!!!

pages.zh: 我再也开不成巴士了。
pages.en: I'm never gonna get to drive the bus.

pages.zh: 嘿……我有个主意。我们来玩游戏吧！
pages.en: Hey... I've got an idea. Let's play a game!

pages.zh: 嘿，那是不是一只鸭子在开巴士？！嘿！！！
pages.en: Hey, is that a duck driving the bus?! Hey!!!

pages.zh: 豆豆和豆包的家务机器人大战 | Doudou and Doubao's Great Chore Robot Battle
pages.en: Doudou and Doubao's Great Chore Robot Battle

pages.zh: 这是关于小男孩豆豆和他的圆滚滚机器人朋友豆包的故事。
pages.en: This is the story of a little boy named Doudou and his round robot friend Doubao.

pages.zh: "今天我们来玩家务大战！"豆豆兴奋地宣布。
pages.en: "Today we're playing the Great Chore Battle!" Doudou announced excitedly.

pages.zh: "看我的臭臭护盾！"豆豆举起一面发着绿色光芒的盾牌。
pages.en: "Behold my Stinky Shield!" Doudou raised a shield glowing with green light.

pages.zh: "我选泡泡枪！砰砰砰！"无数彩色泡泡飞向豆豆。
pages.en: "I choose the Bubble Gun! Bang bang bang!" Countless colorful bubbles flew toward Doudou.

pages.zh: "我的臭臭炮弹早就把你打成臭臭了！"豆豆得意地大笑。
pages.en: "My Stinky Bombs already turned you into a stinker!" Doudou laughed triumphantly.

pages.zh: "肥皂武装！擦呀擦！洗完啦！"豆豆用巨大的肥皂把豆包洗得干干净净。
pages.en: "Soap Attack! Scrub scrub scrub! All clean!" Doudou washed Doubao squeaky clean.

pages.zh: "我的扫地机器人战车来啦！"机械臂伸出，四处清扫。
pages.en: "My Robot Vacuum Tank is here!" Mechanical arms stretched out, sweeping everywhere.

pages.zh: "扫地机器人进入愤怒模式！"对战越来越激烈。
pages.en: "Robot Vacuum enters Angry Mode!" The battle grew more and more intense.

pages.zh: "看我的飞翔盾牌！追踪子弹，穿过豆包的坦克！"
pages.en: "Look at my Flying Shield! Tracking bullets, right through Doubao's tank!"

pages.zh: "好吧好吧，这次算你厉害！"豆包笑着说。"那我们还是做好朋友吧！"
pages.en: "Okay okay, you win this time!" Doubao laughed. "Let's still be best friends!"

pages.zh: 厨房传来一声巨响！"完了完了，妈妈说今天要做蛋糕！"
pages.en: A loud crash came from the kitchen! "Oh no! Mom said we need to bake a cake today!"

pages.zh: "豆包，变成厨房特工模式！"豆豆戴上厨师帽，系上围裙。
pages.en: "Doubao, switch to Kitchen Agent Mode!" Doudou put on a chef's hat and apron.

pages.zh: 豆豆不小心把整袋面粉甩到了空中，像冬天的童话世界！
pages.en: Doudou accidentally flung the entire bag of flour into the air, like a winter wonderland!

pages.zh: 搅拌器转得太快了，面糊像喷泉一样飞溅得到处都是！
pages.en: The mixer spun too fast, sending batter flying everywhere like a fountain!

pages.zh: 豆包偷偷往面糊里加了洗衣液——巨大的彩色泡泡开始淹没厨房！
pages.en: Doubao secretly added laundry detergent to the batter — giant colorful bubbles started flooding the kitchen!

pages.zh: 巨大的泡泡把豆豆和豆包一直飘到了天花板上！
pages.en: The giant bubbles lifted Doudou and Doubao all the way to the ceiling!

pages.zh: "启动反泡泡系统！"豆包一个个戳破了泡泡，安全着陆。
pages.en: "Activate Anti-Bubble System!" Doubao popped the bubbles one by one for a safe landing.

pages.zh: "我的厨房！！！"妈妈站在门口，眼睛里冒着火！
pages.en: "MY KITCHEN!!!" Mom stood at the door, flames shooting from her eyes!

pages.zh: 豆包变成了超级清洁机器人，把厨房打扫得闪闪发亮！
pages.en: Doubao transformed into a Super Cleaning Robot and polished the kitchen sparkling clean!

豆包和小孩准备在外太空玩一场超级星球大战游戏！
pages.en: Doubao and the kid are ready to play an epic planet battle game in outer space!

pages.zh: 豆包说：'我们来玩星球大战吧！你想当绝地武士还是飞船飞行员？'
pages.en: Doubao says: 'Let's play planet battle! Do you want to be a Jedi or a spaceship pilot?'

pages.zh: 豆包设计了一颗水晶能量星球，透明的外壳能发射超强激光炮！
pages.en: Doubao creates a Crystal Energy Planet with a transparent shell that shoots super laser beams!

pages.zh: 小孩设计了一颗小但强大的小小星星，能到处扔水晶炸弹！
pages.en: The kid designs a tiny but mighty Little Star that can throw crystal bombs everywhere!

pages.zh: 水晶能量星球向小小星星发射了一道巨大的激光束！滋——！
pages.en: The Crystal Energy Planet fires a huge laser beam at the Little Star! ZAP!

pages.zh: 小小星星扔出闪亮的水晶炸弹，炸中了水晶星球！轰轰！
pages.en: The Little Star throws sparkling crystal bombs that hit the Crystal Planet! BOOM BOOM!

pages.zh: 炸弹威力太大了，豆包被炸飞到了银河系那边！
pages.en: The bombs are so powerful that Doubao gets blown all the way to the Milky Way!

pages.zh: 还好豆包有弹性身体！像橡皮球一样弹了回来！
pages.en: Luckily Doubao has an elastic body! He bounces right back like a rubber ball!

pages.zh: 豆包的水晶星球变身成了一只星际巨鲸，嘴巴超级大！
pages.en: Doubao's Crystal Planet transforms into a giant Stellar Whale with a super big mouth!

pages.zh: 星际巨鲸张开大嘴，要把小小星星整个吞下去！
pages.en: The Stellar Whale opens its mouth wide to swallow the Little Star whole!

pages.zh: 小孩把银河系沐浴露挤到星际巨鲸身上！到处都是泡泡！
pages.en: The kid squeezes Galaxy Bubble Bath all over the Stellar Whale! Bubbles everywhere!

pages.zh: 小孩掏出一个迷你的打火机，说快跑！咔嚓！
pages.en: The kid pulls out a tiny mini lighter and says 'Quick, run!' CLICK!

pages.zh: 轰！泡泡和打火机引发了大爆炸！豆包和巨鲸一起飞了出去！
pages.en: BOOM! The bubbles and lighter create a HUGE explosion! Doubao and the whale go flying!

pages.zh: 可怜的豆包被炸得全身冒黑烟！水晶星球也裂开了！
pages.en: Poor Doubao is all burnt and covered in black smoke! His crystal planet is cracked!

pages.zh: 豆包放出纳米修复机器人，嗡嗡嗡地飞快修好了一切！
pages.en: Doubao sends out Nano Repair Robots that buzz around fixing everything super fast!

pages.zh: 小孩抓起一面闪亮的保护盾，准备挡住任何反击！
pages.en: The kid grabs a shiny protective shield, ready to block any counterattack!

pages.zh: 小孩不小心把盾牌扔到了豆包的星球上，忘了挡住！'哎呀！'
pages.en: The kid accidentally throws the shield at Doubao's planet instead of blocking! 'Oops!'

pages.zh: 小孩发出了终极报废攻击！星球开始散架变成废铁！
pages.en: The kid launches the ultimate Scrap Attack! The planet starts falling apart into useless junk!

pages.zh: 曾经强大的星球现在只是一堆飘在太空中的废铁！
pages.en: The once powerful planet is now just a pile of scrap metal floating in space!

pages.zh: 豆包举起白旗说：'好好好，你赢了！你的炸弹太厉害了！'
pages.en: Doubao raises a white flag and says: 'OK OK, you win! Your bombs are too strong!'

pages.zh: 豆包和小孩在太空中抱在一起！'太好玩了！明天再玩！'
pages.en: Doubao and the kid hug in space! 'That was so fun! Let's play again tomorrow!'

pages.zh: 他们一起坐着小小星星飞走了，准备迎接下一个精彩的太空冒险！
pages.en: They fly off together on the Little Star, ready for the next amazing space adventure!

contentQuality.note: Nineteen local source illustrations are connected. Pages 3, 8, and 18 use offline SVG fallbacks because the GPT image channel currently has no enabled gpt-image-2 route.

pages.zh: 在一个遥远的星系里，勇敢的小宇航员小星驾驶着他闪亮的蓝色飞船穿越星空。今天，他即将迎来人生中最伟大的冒险！
pages.en: In a faraway galaxy, a brave little astronaut named Little Star flew his shiny blue spaceship through the stars. Today, he was about to have the greatest adventure of his life!

pages.zh: 小星飞过一闪一闪的小星星。它们像撒落在黑暗天空中的小钻石一样闪烁。他看着周围美丽的星球，想该往哪边走。
pages.en: Little Star flew past twinkling little stars. They sparkled like tiny diamonds scattered across the dark sky. He looked at the beautiful planets around him, wondering which way to go.

pages.zh: 突然，一个圆滚滚的小机器人飘了过来！他叫豆豆，有着发光的眼睛和弹弹的身体。他微笑着问小星想不想一起玩星球大战。
pages.en: Suddenly, a round little robot floated over! His name was Doudou, with glowing eyes and a bouncy body. He smiled and asked Little Star if he wanted to play Star Wars together.

pages.zh: 好呀！我们来玩！小星说。豆豆开始设计他自己的星球，这将是最棒的星球！小星也准备好了他的特殊武器。大战即将开始！
pages.en: Sure! Let's play! said Little Star. Doudou started designing his own planet, and it would be the best planet ever! Little Star got his special weapons ready too. The big battle was about to begin!

pages.zh: 豆豆创造了一颗壮观的水晶能量星球！它的外壳是透明的水晶，能吸收恒星的能量。他骄傲地说这是他的水晶星球，能发射超强激光炮！
pages.en: Doudou created a magnificent crystal energy planet! Its shell was made of transparent crystal that could absorb star energy. He proudly said it was his Crystal Planet, and it could fire super laser beams!

pages.zh: 嗖！水晶星球发射出一道明亮的激光！激光太强了，照亮了整个星系。豆豆开心地大笑，叫小星躲开试试！
pages.en: Whoosh! The Crystal Planet fired a bright laser beam! It was so powerful that it lit up the whole galaxy. Doudou laughed happily and told Little Star to try dodging it!

pages.zh: 但是小星非常聪明！他朝水晶星球扔出一颗小小的水晶炸弹。轰！炸弹击中了星球表面，在水晶外壳上炸出了一道大裂纹！
pages.en: But Little Star was very clever! He threw a tiny crystal bomb at the Crystal Planet. BOOM! The bomb hit the surface and cracked the crystal shell right open!

pages.zh: 裂纹像蜘蛛网一样在水晶星球上蔓延。豆豆大吃一惊！他大喊他美丽的星球要碎了。水晶外壳一点一点地开始碎裂。
pages.en: The crack spread across the Crystal Planet like a spider web. Doudou was shocked! He cried that his beautiful planet was breaking apart. The crystal shell began to shatter piece by piece.

pages.zh: 但是豆豆有办法！他派出成百上千个小小的修复无人机。嗡嗡嗡！它们飞到裂缝处开始修复星球。豆豆骄傲地说他的无人机会修好一切！
pages.en: But Doudou had a plan! He sent out hundreds of tiny repair drones. Bzzz! They flew to the cracks and started fixing the planet. Doudou proudly said his drones would fix everything!

pages.zh: 现在豆豆有一个超级惊喜！水晶星球变形成为一只巨大的星际巨鲸！它又大又闪亮，有着水晶鱼鳍和巨大的嘴巴。豆豆大笑着说他的星球可以变形！
pages.en: Now Doudou had a super surprise! The Crystal Planet transformed into a giant Space Whale! It was huge and shiny, with crystal fins and an enormous mouth. Doudou laughed and said his planet could transform!

pages.zh: 星际巨鲸张开超级大的嘴巴，要把小星的小星星吸进来！呼！星星们开始飞向巨鲸的嘴巴。豆豆喊着让星星进入他的能量熔炉！
pages.en: The Space Whale opened its super big mouth, trying to suck in Little Star's stars! Whoosh! The stars started flying toward the whale's mouth. Doudou cheered for the stars to enter his energy furnace!

pages.zh: 小星有了最棒的主意！他抓起一瓶银河系沐浴露，塞进炸药，用一个迷你打火机点燃。他把满是泡泡的炸弹扔向星际巨鲸！
pages.en: Little Star had the best idea ever! He grabbed a bottle of Galaxy Bubble Bath, stuffed it with explosives, and lit it with a mini lighter. He threw the bubbly bomb right at the Space Whale!

pages.zh: 轰！银河系沐浴露炸弹爆炸了！星际巨鲸现在满身都是泡泡！噗噗噗！黑烟从它的水晶身体上升起。豆豆大叫他全身都是泡沫！
pages.en: BOOM! The Galaxy Bubble Bath bomb exploded! The Space Whale was covered in bubbles! Pop, pop, pop! Black smoke rose from its crystal body. Doudou cried that he was full of foam!

pages.zh: 别担心！豆豆也有秘密武器，超小的纳米修复机器人！它们小到根本看不见。它们在星际巨鲸周围飞速修复。豆豆说他的纳米机器人会救他！
pages.en: Don't worry! Doudou had a secret weapon too — super tiny nano repair robots! They were so small you couldn't even see them. They zoomed around the Space Whale fixing it fast. Doudou said his nano robots would save it!

pages.zh: 但是小星没有停下！他制作了终极炸弹，整个宇宙中最大最强的炸弹！它发出明亮的红光，连周围的星星都在震动。他喊着这是他的最后一击！
pages.en: But Little Star didn't stop! He built the ultimate bomb — the biggest and strongest bomb in the whole universe! It glowed bright red and made all the nearby stars shake. He shouted it was his final strike!

pages.zh: 轰隆！终极炸弹击中了星际巨鲸，噗！什么都不剩了！连一小块碎片都没有。豆豆的星球完全消失了。豆豆小声说太厉害了。
pages.en: KA-BOOM! The ultimate bomb hit the Space Whale. Poof! Nothing was left! Not even a tiny piece. Doudou's planet had completely vanished. Doudou whispered that it was incredible.

pages.zh: 但是豆豆是个坚强的小机器人！他收集太空中漂浮的所有废铁，建造了一个全新的星球！虽然没有以前那么闪亮，但它是用爱和决心建造的。
pages.en: But Doudou was a tough little robot! He collected all the scrap metal floating in space and built a brand new planet! It wasn't as shiny as before, but it was built with love and determination.

pages.zh: 小星拿起一个保护盾想送给豆豆。但是哎呀！他扔得太用力，盾牌直接飞向了豆豆！然后他赶紧又来了一个报废攻击！
pages.en: Little Star picked up a shield to give to Doudou. But oh no! He threw it too hard, and the shield flew straight at Doudou! Then he quickly followed with another attack!

pages.zh: 咔嚓！盾牌碎成碎片，新星球变成了一堆废铁。豆豆举起他的小机器人手臂投降了！他说小星的炸弹太厉害了，他认输！
pages.en: CRACK! The shield shattered into pieces, and the new planet turned into a pile of scrap metal. Doudou raised his little robot arm and surrendered! He said Little Star's bombs were too powerful — he gave up!

pages.zh: 虽然他们打了一场史诗级的大战，但小星和豆豆还是最好的朋友！他们互相击掌，一起大笑，喊着这是最好玩的星球大战游戏！
pages.en: Even though they had an epic battle, Little Star and Doudou were still the best of friends! They high-fived, laughed together, and shouted that this was the most fun Star Wars game ever!

pages.zh: 小星看着星星，有了新主意。他跟豆豆说下次去火星吧！豆豆的眼睛兴奋地发亮，喊着火星我们来了！
pages.en: Little Star looked at the stars and had a new idea. He told Doudou they should go to Mars next time! Doudou's eyes lit up with excitement as he shouted — Mars, here we come!

contentQuality.note: Removed duplicated intro page and restored the local high-resolution source sequence.

pages.zh: 你好！我是皮普。
pages.en: Hello! I am Pip.

pages.zh: 我有一辆红色的汽车。
pages.en: I have a red car.

pages.zh: 我有两只黄色的鸭子。
pages.en: I have two yellow ducks.

pages.zh: 我有三个蓝色的球。
pages.en: I have three blue balls.

pages.zh: 我有四只绿色的青蛙。
pages.en: I have four green frogs.

pages.zh: 我有五只粉色的兔子。
pages.en: I have five pink rabbits.

pages.zh: 这是我的玩具箱。
pages.en: This is my toy box.

pages.zh: 我爱我的玩具！
pages.en: I love my toys!

pages.zh: 再见，玩具箱！明天见！
pages.en: Goodbye, toy box! See you tomorrow!

pages.zh: 结束。
pages.en: The End.

pages.zh: 在一个被青山环绕的小村庄里，住着一个爱动手做东西的勇敢小孩。
pages.en: In a small village surrounded by green hills, there lived a brave little kid who loved building things.

pages.zh: 工坊里，小孩一直在秘密制造一件了不起的东西——一辆全蔬菜做的坦克！
pages.en: Inside the workshop, the kid had been building something amazing — a tank made entirely of vegetables!

pages.zh: 小孩把一根空心甘蔗装上去当炮管，闻起来像糖果一样甜！
pages.en: The kid attached a hollow sugarcane tube as the cannon barrel. It smelled sweet like candy!

pages.zh: 圆圆的棕色土豆雷被装进坦克后面的弹仓，每个都裹着黏糊糊的金色糖浆。
pages.en: Round brown potato mines were loaded into the back of the tank, each coated in sticky golden syrup.

pages.zh: 小牛奶穿上了一件特别的小背心，口袋里装着烟雾弹，小狗兴奋地摇着尾巴！
pages.en: Little Milk got a special tiny harness with pockets for smoke bombs. The puppy wagged its tail excitedly!

pages.zh: 最大的秘密武器——掏空的南瓜壳里装着魔法生长种子，能无限分裂繁殖！
pages.en: The biggest surprise — hollow pumpkin shells filled with magic growing seeds that could multiply forever!

pages.zh: 甘蔗坦克终于完工了！它有甘蔗炮、土豆雷发射器和南瓜弹仓。
pages.en: The sugarcane tank was finally complete! It had a sugarcane cannon, potato mine launcher, and pumpkin bomb bay.

pages.zh: 突然，村庄响起了警报——敌人的坦克正从东边逼近！
pages.en: Suddenly, a loud alarm echoed through the village — enemy tanks were approaching from the east!

pages.zh: 十辆钢铁大坦克开进了村庄，压坏了栅栏，把大家都吓跑了。
pages.en: Ten big steel tanks rolled into the village, crushing fences and scaring everyone away.

pages.zh: "是时候保护我们的家了！"小孩跳进甘蔗坦克，发动了引擎。
pages.en: 'It's time to protect our home!' The kid jumped into the sugarcane tank and started the engine.

pages.zh: 砰！甘蔗炮发射了一发黏糊糊的糖浆弹，糊住了第一辆敌人坦克的履带！
pages.en: BANG! The sugarcane cannon fired a sticky syrup bomb that splattered all over the first enemy tank's tracks!

pages.zh: 小孩按下连射按钮，糖浆弹四处飞射，把敌人坦克全部粘在了地上！
pages.en: The kid pressed the rapid fire button and syrup bombs flew everywhere, gluing enemy tanks to the ground!

pages.zh: 小牛奶叼着粉色烟雾弹偷偷溜出去，在敌人坦克腿之间跑来跑去！
pages.en: Little Milk sneaked out with a pink smoke bomb in mouth, running between the enemy tanks' legs!

pages.zh: 砰！烟雾弹炸开了，战场上到处都是粉色烟雾，敌人什么也看不见！
pages.en: BOOM! The smoke bomb exploded filling the battlefield with thick pink smoke. The enemies couldn't see anything!

pages.zh: 一辆比其他坦克大三倍的敌人队长坦克冲破了烟雾！
pages.en: A huge enemy commander tank, three times bigger than the others, pushed through the smoke!

pages.zh: "该用南瓜弹了！"小孩按下仪表盘上的大红色按钮。
pages.en: 'Time for the pumpkin bomb!' The kid pressed the big red button on the dashboard.

pages.zh: 嗖——一颗发光的巨大南瓜炮弹从炮管飞出，旋转着飞向天空！
pages.en: WHOOSH! A giant glowing pumpkin bomb launched from the cannon, spinning through the sky!

pages.zh: 南瓜弹命中了队长坦克，炸开变成巨大的南瓜壳，把敌人整个包住了！
pages.en: The pumpkin bomb hit the commander tank and exploded into a giant pumpkin shell, trapping it completely!

pages.zh: 然后不可思议的事情发生了——魔法种子发芽了！一个南瓜变十个，再变一百个，再变几千个！
pages.en: Then something incredible happened — the magic seeds sprouted! One pumpkin became ten, then a hundred, then thousands!

pages.zh: 粗壮的绿色南瓜藤蔓长得比闪电还快，缠住了每一个敌人坦克、卡车和武器！
pages.en: Thick green pumpkin vines grew faster than lightning, wrapping around every enemy tank, truck, and weapon!

pages.zh: 敌人队长从南瓜壳里伸出白旗投降："我们认输了！你们的蔬菜太厉害了！"
pages.en: The enemy commander waved a white flag from inside the pumpkin. 'We give up! Your vegetables are too powerful!'

pages.zh: 在方块的世界里，有一个玩家有一个大梦想——造坦克！
pages.en: In the world of blocks, a player had a big dream — to build tanks!

pages.zh: 他捣鼓了好几天，一个方块一个方块地拼。第一辆，是皮糙肉厚的重型坦克！
pages.en: He worked for days, placing blocks one by one. First, a heavy tank with thick iron armor!

pages.zh: 然后是一辆轻型坦克，在平原上跑起来飞快！
pages.en: Then a light tank that zooms across the plains super fast!

pages.zh: 最后还造了一辆导弹坦克！发射的时候导弹拖着火焰飞出去，超炫酷！
pages.en: And finally, a missile tank! When it fires, the missiles fly high with fiery trails!

pages.zh: 三辆坦克停在车库里整整齐齐。他迫不及待要开出去浪了！
pages.en: All three tanks lined up in the garage. The player could not wait any longer!

pages.zh: 他开着重型坦克直接冲到怪物窝旁边。到处都是僵尸和骷髅！
pages.en: He drove the heavy tank straight to the monster nest. Zombies and skeletons were everywhere!

pages.zh: 轰！一炮下去怪物直接炸飞一大片，太解压了！
pages.en: BOOM! One shot from the cannon and monsters went flying everywhere! So satisfying!

pages.zh: 坦克横冲直撞！怪物根本近不了身！
pages.en: The heavy tank charged right through! Monsters could not get anywhere near it!

pages.zh: 几下就把整片怪物窝清干净了，他在坦克里开心地欢呼！
pages.en: In no time, the whole monster nest was cleared. The player cheered inside the tank!

pages.zh: 再也不用拿剑躲躲藏藏了！有坦克就是不一样！
pages.en: No more hiding with a sword! Tanks make everything so much easier!

pages.zh: 成就感直接拉满！但这只是开始...
pages.en: Achievement unlocked! The player felt so proud. But this was just the beginning...

pages.zh: 他专门建了一个坦克阵地，有围墙、炮台，还有红石大炮！
pages.en: The player built a special tank base with walls, turrets, and redstone cannons!

pages.zh: 所有坦克整整齐齐停在里面。重型、轻型、导弹坦克随时待命！
pages.en: All the tanks were parked neatly. Heavy, light, and missile tanks ready for action!

pages.zh: 阵地周围摆满了红石大炮，防止怪物偷袭！
pages.en: Redstone cannons surrounded the base to stop any monsters from sneaking in!

pages.zh: 夜幕降临。一大群怪物从黑暗中涌了出来！
pages.en: Night fell. A huge wave of monsters appeared from the darkness!

pages.zh: 怪物里面还有几只循声守卫，又大又凶，超可怕！
pages.en: Among them were Warden Sentinels — big, tough, and super scary!

pages.zh: 他赶紧跳进最近的坦克，发动引擎！
pages.en: The player jumped into the nearest tank and started the engine!

pages.zh: 还好旁边有铁傀儡，马上加入战斗！
pages.en: Luckily, Iron Golems were nearby and joined the battle!

pages.zh: 铁傀儡在前面扛伤害，什么打过来都不怕。太硬了！
pages.en: Iron Golem blocked the front, taking all the hits. What a tough guy!

pages.zh: 循声守卫血太厚，普通炮弹根本打不动！
pages.en: The Warden Sentinel had too much health! Normal cannonballs barely scratched it!

pages.zh: 赶紧换导弹坦克！一发导弹下去直接打掉大半血！
pages.en: Quick, switch to the missile tank! One missile took away half its health!

pages.zh: 差点被怪物包围！赶紧操控坦克边退边射击！
pages.en: Monsters were surrounding them! Time to back up and keep shooting!

pages.zh: 靠着坦克厚厚的装甲硬扛伤害，一边扛一边打回去！
pages.en: Thanks to the tank's thick armor, it could handle the damage while fighting back!

pages.zh: 铁傀儡和坦克完美配合，终于守住了阵地！
pages.en: The Iron Golem and tank worked together perfectly. The base was saved!

pages.zh: 普通怪物太简单了，是时候挑战真正的BOSS了！
pages.en: Regular monsters were too easy now. It was time for a real boss fight!

pages.zh: 摆好灵魂沙和骷髅头，凋零被召唤出来了！三个脑袋，超级强大！
pages.en: Soul sand and skulls arranged. The Wither was summoned! Three heads, super powerful!

pages.zh: 一辆坦克根本不够！凋零的炸弹太猛了！
pages.en: One tank was not enough! The Wither's bombs were too powerful!

pages.zh: 坦克掉血超快，差点被打爆！赶紧跑回阵地！
pages.en: The tank was losing health fast. Run back to the base!

pages.zh: 把所有造好的坦克都开出来，组成坦克大军！
pages.en: Time to bring out ALL the tanks! A tank army was forming!

pages.zh: 坦克大军把凋零围了起来，所有坦克一起开火！
pages.en: The tank army surrounded the Wither. Every tank aimed and fired!

pages.zh: 重型坦克在正面扛伤害，挡住凋零的猛烈攻击！
pages.en: Heavy tanks blocked the front, absorbing the Wither's devastating blows!

pages.zh: 轻型坦克绕到侧面，从各个角度攻击凋零！
pages.en: Light tanks zoomed around the sides, hitting the Wither from every angle!

pages.zh: 导弹坦克在远处发射，每发导弹都造成巨大伤害！
pages.en: Missile tanks fired from far away. Each missile dealt massive damage!

pages.zh: 连红石大炮也不停开火！轰轰轰！
pages.en: Even the redstone cannons joined in! Boom boom boom!

pages.zh: 打了好久好久，凋零终于被打败了！胜利！
pages.en: After a long hard fight, the Wither finally fell! Victory!

pages.zh: 掉落了下界之星！是时候造更厉害的东西了！
pages.en: A Nether Star dropped! Time to build something even more amazing!

pages.zh: 下一步：造一辆三层加厚护甲的超级坦克，谁也打不动！
pages.en: Next up: a super tank with triple-layer armor that nothing can destroy!

pages.zh: 那天晚上，麦克斯穿上他的狼外套，搞了这样那样的恶作剧。
pages.en: The night Max wore his wolf suit and made mischief of one kind and another.

pages.zh: 妈妈叫他"小野兽！"麦克斯说"我要把你吃掉！"于是他没吃晚饭就被关进了房间。
pages.en: His mother called him "WILD THING!" and Max said "I'LL EAT YOU UP!" so he was sent to bed without eating anything.

pages.zh: 就在那天晚上，麦克斯的房间里长出了一片森林。
pages.en: That very night in Max's room a forest grew.

pages.zh: 长啊，长啊，直到天花板上挂满了藤蔓，墙壁变成了周围的世界。
pages.en: And grew and grew until his ceiling hung with vines and the walls became the world all around.

pages.zh: 一片海洋翻滚而来，为麦克斯送来了一条小船，他日夜航行，一周又一周，几乎一整年，终于来到了野兽出没的地方。
pages.en: And an ocean tumbled by with a private boat for Max, and he sailed off through night and day and in and out of weeks and almost over a year to where the wild things are.

pages.zh: 当他来到野兽出没的地方，它们发出可怕的吼声，磨着可怕的牙齿，转着可怕的眼睛，伸出可怕的爪子。
pages.en: And when he came to the place where the wild things are, they roared their terrible roars and gnashed their terrible teeth and rolled their terrible eyes and showed their terrible claws.

pages.zh: "不许动！"麦克斯说，用魔法般的眼神——一眨不眨地盯住它们所有的黄眼睛——驯服了它们。它们害怕了，说他是全世界最野的野兽。
pages.en: "BE STILL!" Max said and tamed them with the magic trick of staring into all their yellow eyes without blinking once. And they were frightened and called him the most wild thing of all.

pages.zh: "现在，"麦克斯喊道，"让野兽狂欢开始吧！"
pages.en: "And now," cried Max, "let the wild rumpus start!"

pages.zh: （野兽狂欢——麦克斯和野兽们在丛林里跳舞、荡来荡去。）
pages.en: (The wild rumpus - Max and the wild things dance and swing through the jungle.)

pages.zh: （狂欢继续——它们爬上树梢，对着月亮嚎叫。）
pages.en: (The wild rumpus continues - they all climb trees and howl at the moon.)

pages.zh: （狂欢——麦克斯骑在野兽王的肩膀上。）
pages.en: (The wild rumpus - Max rides on the king's shoulders.)

pages.zh: "现在停下！"麦克斯说，没给野兽们吃晚饭就让它们上床睡觉了。
pages.en: "Now stop!" Max said and sent the wild things off to bed without their supper.

pages.zh: 麦克斯，所有野兽的王，感到孤独了，他想回到有人最爱他的地方。这时，从遥远的世界另一边飘来了好吃的香味，于是他放弃了做野兽国的王。
pages.en: And Max the king of all wild things was lonely and wanted to be where someone loved him best of all. Then all around from far away across the world he smelled good things to eat so he gave up being king of where the wild things are.

pages.zh: 但野兽们喊道："哦，请别走——我们要把你吃掉——我们好爱你！"麦克斯说："不！"
pages.en: But the wild things cried, "Oh please don't go—we'll eat you up—we love you so!" And Max said, "No!"

pages.zh: 野兽们发出可怕的吼声，磨着可怕的牙齿，转着可怕的眼睛，伸出可怕的爪子，但麦克斯踏上了他的小船，挥手告别。
pages.en: The wild things made their terrible roars and gnashed their terrible teeth and rolled their terrible eyes and showed their terrible claws, but Max stepped into his private boat and waved goodbye.

pages.zh: 他又日夜航行，一周又一周，几乎一整年。
pages.en: And he sailed back through night and day and in and out of weeks and almost over a year.

pages.zh: 他回到房间，发现晚饭正等着他。
pages.en: And he found his supper waiting for him.

pages.zh: 而且，还是热的。
pages.en: And it was still hot.

pages.zh: 女巫温妮住在一座黑房子里。房子外面是黑的，里面也是黑的。地毯是黑的。椅子是黑的。床是黑的。连浴室都是黑的。
pages.en: Winnie the Witch lived in a black house. The house was black on the outside and black on the inside. The carpets were black. The chairs were black. The bed was black. Even the bathroom was black.

pages.zh: 温妮和她的猫威尔伯住在黑房子里。威尔伯是一只黑猫。这就是问题所在。
pages.en: Winnie lived in her black house with her cat, Wilbur. Wilbur was a black cat. That was the problem.

pages.zh: 威尔伯睁着眼睛坐在椅子上时，温妮能看到他。她能看到他的眼睛。但威尔伯一闭眼睡觉，温妮就完全看不见他了。她就会一屁股坐到威尔伯身上。
pages.en: When Wilbur sat on a chair with his eyes open, Winnie could see him. She could see his eyes. But when Wilbur closed his eyes and went to sleep, Winnie couldn't see him at all. She would sit on him.

pages.zh: 于是温妮挥舞她的魔法棒，念道："阿布拉卡达布拉！"
pages.en: So Winnie waved her magic wand and said, "ABRACADABRA!"

pages.zh: 威尔伯不再是一只黑猫了。他成了一只亮绿色的猫！现在不管威尔伯去哪儿，温妮都能看见他。
pages.en: Wilbur was no longer a black cat. He was a bright green cat! Now Winnie could see Wilbur wherever he went.

pages.zh: 但威尔伯跑到了外面。他坐在草地上。温妮骑着自行车冲出来，砰！撞到了他。威尔伯坐在草地上时她又看不见他了。
pages.en: But Wilbur went outside. He sat on the grass. Winnie rushed out on her bicycle and BANG! She crashed into him. She could not see him when he sat on the grass.

pages.zh: 于是温妮又挥舞魔法棒，念道："阿布拉卡达布拉！"现在威尔伯变成了一只绿猫，但有着红脑袋、红身体和红尾巴！一只非常花哨的猫。
pages.en: So Winnie waved her magic wand again and said, "ABRACADABRA!" Now Wilbur was a green cat with a red head, a red body, and a red tail! A very stripy cat.

pages.zh: 不管威尔伯去哪儿温妮都能看见他了。但威尔伯很不开心。他看起来傻极了。鸟儿们都看着他笑。威尔伯很难过。
pages.en: Winnie could see Wilbur wherever he went. But Wilbur was very unhappy. He looked silly. The birds looked at him and laughed. Wilbur was sad.

pages.zh: 温妮也很难过。她爱威尔伯。"我会让你重新开心的，"她说。
pages.en: Winnie was sad too. She loved Wilbur. "I'll make you happy again," she said.

pages.zh: 她挥舞魔法棒，喊道："阿布拉卡达布拉！"威尔伯又变回了一只黑猫。然后温妮又挥舞了五次魔法棒。
pages.en: She waved her magic wand and shouted, "ABRACADABRA!" Wilbur was a black cat again. Then Winnie waved her wand five more times.

pages.zh: 房子不再是黑色的了。屋顶是红的，墙是黄的，门是绿的，椅子是粉的，地毯是白色带彩色花朵的，床是蓝色的，浴室是绿色和金色的。
pages.en: The house was no longer black. The roof was red. The walls were yellow. The door was green. The chairs were pink. The carpet was white with colorful flowers. The bed was blue. The bathroom was green and gold.

pages.zh: 现在温妮总能看见威尔伯了。就算他闭着眼睛坐在楼梯上也看得见。威尔伯很开心。因为楼梯是蓝色、粉色、黄色、绿色、红色和白色的。多么美妙的房子啊！
pages.en: So now Winnie can always see Wilbur. Even when he sits on the stairs with his eyes closed. And Wilbur is happy. Because the stairs are blue and pink and yellow and green and red and white. What a wonderful house!
